description: This file provides an extensive low-level design overview of the Leads module in vtiger CRM, including class responsibilities, database schema interactions, workflows, and webservice-based lead conversion logic. It details module architecture, key classes like Leads and ConvertLeadUI, database relationships, and handling procedures for create, save, delete, merge, mass edit, relate/unrelate, and lead conversion workflows, as well as internal interactions among core components, webservices, and UI.

classes.name: Leads
classes.description: Main entity class representing the Leads module, handling persistence, relationships, list/search configurations, and data retrieval for Lead records.

classes.name: ConvertLeadUI
classes.description: Helper class facilitating the loading, validation, and default value determination for the Lead conversion UI. Coordinates permitted module and field visibility checks, and field mappings for conversion.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a CRMEntity-derived class for a specific module.

methods.name: CRMEntity::retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Loads record data for a given entity ID and module into the object.

methods.name: CRMEntity::save
methods.description: Handles the save workflow: triggers events, calls saveentity, and persists data across core tables.

methods.name: CRMEntity::saveentity
methods.description: Performs the actual database insert/update for the entity, including vtiger_crmentity and module-specific tables.

methods.name: CRMEntity::save_related_module
methods.description: Persists relationships between entities, e.g., for related modules like Campaigns or Products.

methods.name: CRMEntity::mark_deleted
methods.description: Implements soft deletion by setting deleted flag.

methods.name: Leads::create_export_query
methods.description: Generates SQL for exporting lead data, respecting permissions and non-admin access.

methods.name: Leads::get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activity records linked to a specific lead for related list display.

methods.name: Leads::get_emails
methods.description: Retrieves email-related activities associated with a lead.

methods.name: Leads::get_campaigns
methods.description: Fetches campaigns linked to a lead.

methods.name: Leads::get_products
methods.description: Lists products related to the lead.

methods.name: Leads::transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers all related records from multiple leads to a primary lead during duplicate merge.

methods.name: Leads::unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes a relationship between a lead and other modules, e.g., campaigns or products.

methods.name: ConvertLeadUI::__construct
methods.description: Loads the lead record and associated data for display in the lead conversion UI.

methods.name: ConvertLeadUI::getLeadInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the lead details from the database for UI population.

methods.name: ConvertLeadUI::setAssignedToInfo
methods.description: Determines default owner (user or group) for lead conversion.

methods.name: ConvertLeadUI::isModuleActive
methods.description: Checks whether a module (e.g., Accounts or Contacts) is active and permitted.

methods.name: ConvertLeadUI::getMappedFieldValue
methods.description: Provides default values for mapped fields during conversion, ensuring validity and defaults.
